parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the frequency of an alternating current.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
An alternating current *I* in a resistor of resistance 680 Ω varies with time *t* according to

*I* = 3.5 sin (40π*t*)

where *I* is in A and *t* is in s.
parts.text: Show that the period of the alternating current is 50 ms.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
On Fig. 8.1, sketch the variation of *I* with *t* between *t* = 0 and *t* = 100 ms.

[[fig:f1]]

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) current in the resistor.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use data from (b), including your answer in (b)(ii), to show by calculation that the mean power in the 680 Ω resistor is half of the peak power.

figures.caption: Fig. 8.1
figures.alt: A blank grid graph with vertical axis *I* / A marked from −4 to 4 and horizontal axis *t* / ms marked from 0 to 100.
